# Audnexus.bundle

This mod adds djdembeck/Audnexus.bundle.

Add it to the `plex` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-audnexus
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-audnexus|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

This mod was created based upon the [plex-absolute-hama](https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-mods/tree/plex-absolute-hama) mod.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/plex-audnexus/
